newsitem.title: USA: BARR gets FDA nod for generic blood-thinner.
newsitem.headline: BARR gets FDA nod for generic blood-thinner.

text.p: Barr Laboratories Inc said on Wednesday it won U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval to market seven strengths of Warfarin Sodium tablets, a generic equivalent of DuPont Merck's anti-coagulant Coumadin.
Barr said Coumadin is the 11th-most prescribed product in the United States, with current annual sales of about $500 million.
Barr expects to begin shipping Warfarin this summer.
Barr makes generic pharmaceuticals. Its stock rose 4-5/8 to 36-1/2 on Wednesday.
DuPont Merck is co-owned by DuPont Co and Merck and Co Inc.
